description: Joanna Robinson is running for State Representative because working people in Oregon House District 15 (representing Albany, Millersburg, and Tangent) deserve a representative who will show up and fight for them. What matters to you matters to Joanna —housing you can afford, healthcare you can reach, schools set up to succeed, taxes that are fair, and work that treats you with respect. That's what she’ll fight for in Salem.
